audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart hands six of seven rows to Poppy at a 50.36% win rate, while the packet chart reads Skill/Camille x5/Skill — and the page's own late-game prose says Camille takes over.
audit.why: I did not flip it. The mirror (camille__poppy) reached the same conclusion and deliberately left every row untouched rather than half-fix it; flipping only our side would put the two directions in direct conflict, and our own whys[1]/whys[2] argue for Poppy at levels 2-3 while the packet argues for Camille. This needs one decision applied to both sides at once.
audit.corrected: Left as-is and raised for the user; mirror-fix.js or a hand edit should settle both directions together.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one cooldown on the page.
audit.why: Hookshot 16s at rank 1 (12s maxed), Tactical Sweep 15s, Precision Protocol 9s and The Hextech Ultimatum 140/115/90 are the windows the whole plan hangs on.
audit.corrected: 16s, 15s and 140s written into dosFull[0], the cooldown block and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: Adaptive Defenses (P) and the Precision Protocol auto-reset were never mentioned, and Tactical Sweep was twice called a 'true-damage cone' — it is a cone whose outer half slows, deals extra damage and heals Camille.
audit.why: Riot's text: P shields her against the damage type of every champion auto she lands, so the burst window Poppy needs is eaten unless it is forced out first; Q empowers her next attack and recasts for much more if she delays; W's outer half is the heal. Steadfast Presence stopping Hookshot and the R dash is correct and kept.
audit.corrected: Shield and auto-reset named as things to bait and read; the phantom true damage on W replaced with its real heal.

audit.why: Anti-heal advice in report[8] is genuinely right here — Tactical Sweep's outer half heals her off Riot's own text.
audit.corrected: Kept, and reinforced with the ability name in the cooldown block.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are about your wall-stun, not raw damage. Her whole kit wants to E-hookshot in and second-cast off a wall, so position with a wall behind YOU, not her — when she dashes in, E her into your wall for the stun and chunk her with max-HP Q. Don't waste W early; her real dash threat is her engage and you want Steadfast Presence up to ground it. At 2-3 your Q+E combo lets you punish any aggressive E she throws out of position.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are about your wall-stun, not raw damage. Hookshot is 16s at rank 1 and wants to second-cast off a wall, so position with a wall behind YOU, not her — when she dashes in, E her into your wall for the stun and chunk her with max-HP Q. Don't waste W early; keep Steadfast Presence up for that engage. Her combo opens on a Precision Protocol auto reset, so step back on the wind-up, not on the cast.

edits.before: The lane stays roughly even and your job is denying her windows. At 6 your ultimate is a peel/displacement tool, but the real key is W: hold Steadfast Presence for her E engage or her R isolation dash — grounding her cancels the dash mid-flight and stops the duel before it starts. Bait her to commit E, eat the ground, and she's stuck in front of you with no escape and your Q chunking her. Respect her W cone heal in extended trades; keep trades short so she can't refund.
edits.after: The lane stays roughly even and your job is denying her windows. At 6 your ultimate is peel and displacement, but the real key is W: hold Steadfast Presence for Hookshot or her R dash — stopping it grounds and slows her, ending the duel before it starts. Bait the 16s E, stop it, and she is stuck in front of you with your Q chunking her. Tactical Sweep's outer half heals her every 15s, so keep trades short and get anti-heal on time.

notes: Two flags I did not write from: _missing-interactions calls The Hextech Ultimatum an untargetability window, but Riot's text for it is only a dash, an anchor zone and bonus magic damage on her autos — no untargetability, so I made no such claim. Tactical Sweep was also being described as true damage in two places; Riot's text gives it extra damage plus a heal on the outer half, which is what I wrote. The level chart is the open item: six of seven rows say Poppy at a 50.36% win rate against a packet chart of Skill/Camille x5/Skill, and the mirror left it alone for the same reason I did.
